question: Among customers who paid more than 20.00 per unit for product ID 5 in transactions dated 2012, which customer segment had the highest percentage of customers whose total consumption in 2012 was below 30,000?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001 AS cid, c.XCL_002 AS segment
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
  WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
    AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
    AND (t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017) > 20.00
),
consumption AS (
  SELECT q.cid, q.segment, SUM(y.XCL_021) AS total
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN yearmonth AS y ON q.cid = y.XCL_019
  WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
  GROUP BY q.cid, q.segment
)
SELECT segment
FROM consumption
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN total < 30000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
)

    segment
FROM segment_stats
ORDER BY (low_consumption_customers * 1.0 / total_customers) DESC
LIMIT 1
